publisher.title: The Spec
full_article:
KATHMANDU, Nepal (AP) — A provincial government in Nepal has legalized farming and use of marijuana for medical use despite a national ban.

The bill went into effect Monday after it was endorsed by the chief of Gandaki province and allows the farming and medical use of cannabis, said Prabin Poudyal, spokesman for the office of the Chief of Gandaki Province.

Farmers will have to get official permission from the provincial authority and are to be closely monitored.

ARTICLE CONTINUES BELOW

The provincial law comes despite a national ban on farming, possession and use of marijuana. Anyone possessing marijuana for personal use can be jailed for a month, while distribution and sales are punishable by up to 10 years’ imprisonment depending on the amount seized.

Gandaki, one of the Himalayan country’s seven provinces, is home to popular mountains and hiking trails and the resort city of Pokhara.

Cannabis is native to Nepal and is widely used during festivals, and activists in Nepal have been trying to get the government to change the law to allow it.

Marijuana was once widely embedded in the country’s culture and religion.

But in the late 1970s, the country followed other nations in outlawing marijuana, and chased away the hippies who had flocked to the country.

title: Constitutional Expert Urges Serious Consideration of International Concerns Regarding Nepal's Judiciary - Ratopati
description: Constitutional Expert Urges Serious Consideration of International Concerns Regarding Nepal's Judiciary  Ratopati
publisher.title: Ratopati
full_article:
Kathmandu. Constitutional expert Bipin Adhikari has stated that the questions raised by international human rights organizations regarding the independence of Nepal's judiciary should be taken seriously.

Speaking at the meeting of the Law, Justice and Human Rights Committee under the House of Representatives on Wednesday, Adhikari argued that the recently published international reports have indicated serious threats to the Nepali judiciary, and therefore, these cannot be ignored.

Constitutional expert Adhikari stated that the joint statement issued by organizations such as Amnesty International, Human Rights Watch, and the International Commission of Jurists (ICJ) is not merely a general human rights report but an assessment of the crisis seen in Nepal's judiciary. He informed that the report focuses on four main issues.

He mentioned that the international community is closely observing the political influence among Supreme Court justices, the lack of sufficient grounds for impeachment, the comments made against specific justices Sapana Pradhan Malla, Kumar Regmi, and Hari Phuyal, and the deviation seen in the appointment of the Chief Justice. Speaking at the meeting, he said, 'Even after such a long democratic practice, political influence within the judiciary, baseless impeachment, and criticism against justices have caused serious concern.'

He added, 'The government should demand credible evidence from these organizations for their claims. If actions have tarnished the image of the judiciary, a commitment should be made to conduct an impartial investigation.'

Commenting on the government's response, Adhikari stated that while it is natural for the Law Minister to call the allegations baseless, it is crucial to factually refute them diplomatically and legally. He clarified that international organizations adhere to the 'no harm' rule, keeping their sources confidential, and therefore, they do not always publicize the information they obtain. However, he added that such organizations do not publicly release their opinions without independent verification at the international level.

title: Large Number of NGOs Inactive in Nepal - Ratopati
description: Large Number of NGOs Inactive in Nepal  Ratopati
publisher.title: Ratopati
full_article:
Kathmandu. A large number of non-governmental organizations registered in Nepal have been found to be inactive. This information was given by Chakrabahadur Budha, member-secretary of the Social Welfare Council and joint-secretary of the Ministry of Women, Children and Senior Citizens, at the meeting of the Law, Justice and Human Rights Committee under the House of Representatives on Wednesday.

According to member-secretary Budha, out of about 60,000 non-governmental organizations (NGOs) affiliated with the Social Welfare Council so far, only about 10,000 are active. Similarly, although there is a record of about 250 international non-governmental organizations (INGOs) working in Nepal so far, only 136 organizations are currently in operation with active projects.

While providing information about the activities and legal procedures of various international organizations at the committee meeting, member-secretary Budha clarified the current status of the International Commission of Jurists (ICJ). The ICJ started working in Nepal since 2009 and renewed its agreement for 5 years on February 25, 2022.

This organization has been working in the areas of transitional justice, human rights, Supreme Court precedents, and legal rights of victim groups. Currently, the organization has proposed a new project called 'Enable' for the rights of women and girls with disabilities, and that proposal is currently under discussion in the facilitation committee of the ministry.

Regarding Amnesty International Nepal, it has been affiliated with the Council since 2062 BS and its affiliation will remain valid until the end of Asar, 2083 BS. Amnesty has approved a project related to human rights campaigns and advocacy for 2026 with a budget of 5 crore 15 lakh 42 thousand 540 rupees. The Council's records show that foreign aid for this will be received from the international secretariat based in London.

title: Nepal Medical Association Demands Government Action for Striking Intern Doctor - Ratopati
description: Nepal Medical Association Demands Government Action for Striking Intern Doctor  Ratopati
publisher.title: Ratopati
full_article:
Kathmandu. The Nepal Medical Association has demanded that the government save the life of intern doctor Dilli Harijan, who is on a hunger strike. Harijan has been on strike since July 19 with various demands including remuneration and respect for labor.

Issuing a press release on July 20, the association announced its full support for the demands of the striking doctor. Harijan has put forward the main demand of receiving equal remuneration for equal work. Similarly, his demand is that the recommendations given by the previously formed task force on the issue of intern doctors should be implemented immediately. The association has supported all these demands.

The association believes that these demands raised for the welfare of intern doctors are justified. The press release issued by the association's president Dr. Badri Rizal and general secretary Dr. Bishwaraj Dawadi expressed solidarity with the movement of intern doctors.

The association has also pressured the government to properly address the demands raised to save the life of the striking doctor.

title: An old, unrelated video from Delhi is falsely shared, linking it to the 2026 unrest in Nepal - FACTLY
description: An old, unrelated video from Delhi is falsely shared, linking it to the 2026 unrest in Nepal  FACTLY
publisher.title: FACTLY
full_article:
A A A

Communal violence broke out in Nepal’s Sunsari district on 27 July 2026 after clashes between Hindu and Muslim groups during separate religious events. The confrontation reportedly began over disputes involving loud music and the display of religious flags, escalating into stone-pelting, arson, and attacks on property. The unrest later spread to several areas of Madhesh Province, prompting authorities to impose curfews, deploy additional security personnel, and appeal for calm. Several people, including security personnel, were injured in the violence, while investigations were launched to identify those responsible (here, here, and here).

In this context, a video is being shared on social media (here, here, and here) with the claim that it shows protesters climbing a mosque’s minaret amid rising smoke, removing an existing flag, and hoisting a saffron (Bhagwa) flag in its place. Let’s verify the claim made in the post in this article.

The archived post can be found here.

Claim: The video shows protesters climbing a mosque’s minaret and hoisting a saffron (Bhagwa) flag amid 2026 unrest in Nepal. Fact: The video does not show protesters climbing a mosque minaret and hoisting a saffron (Bhagwa) flag during the 2026 unrest in Nepal. It is an old video from February 2020 showing the vandalisation of the Badi Mosque in Delhi’s Ashok Nagar during the CAA-related communal violence. Hence, the claim made in the post is Misleading.

A reverse image search of key frames from the viral video led us to multiple media reports (here, here, and here) published in February 2020 featuring the same visuals. According to these reports, the video shows the vandalisation of the Badi Mosque in Delhi’s Ashok Nagar during the communal violence linked to protests against the Citizenship Amendment Act (CAA). The mosque was set on fire, and a mob climbed its minaret, removed the existing flag, and hoisted the Indian national flag along with a saffron Hanuman flag. The visuals in these reports match the viral video, confirming that it is an old video from Delhi in February 2020 and not related to the 2026 unrest in Nepal.

We also found multiple other media reports covering the same incident, which can be seen here, here, and here.

The 2020 Delhi riots took place from 23 to 27 February in North-East Delhi amid clashes over the Citizenship (Amendment) Act (CAA). The violence claimed 53 lives and caused widespread damage to homes, businesses, and places of worship (here, here).

To sum up, an old, unrelated video from Delhi is falsely shared, linking it to the 2026 unrest in Nepal.

नेपाल के सुनसरी जिला में 27 जुलाई 2026 के अलग-अलग धार्मिक आयोजन के दौरान हिन्दू आ मुस्लिम समूह के बीच झड़प के बाद साम्प्रदायिक हिंसा भड़कल छल। खबर छै कि ई मुठभेड़ जोर-जोर स॑ संगीत आरू धार्मिक झंडा केरऽ प्रदर्शन स॑ जुड़लऽ विवाद के चलतें शुरू होलऽ छेलै, जेकरा स॑ बढ़ी क॑ पत्थरबाजी, आगजनी आरू संपत्ति प॑ हमला होय गेलै । बाद मे अशांति मधेश प्रांतक कतेको इलाका मे पसरल जाहि सँ अधिकारि लोकनि कर्फ्यू लगा देलनि, अतिरिक्त सुरक्षाकर्मी तैनात केलनि, आ शांतताक अपील केलनि। हिंसा म॑ सुरक्षाकर्मी सहित कई लोग घायल होय गेलै, जबकि जिम्मेदारऽ के पहचान करै लेली जांच शुरू करलऽ गेलै (एत॑, यहाँ, आरू यहाँ) ।

एहि संदर्भ मे सोशल मीडिया (एतय, एतय, आ एतय) पर एकटा वीडियो शेयर कएल जा रहल अछि जाहि मे दावा कएल जा रहल अछि जे एहि मे प्रदर्शनकारी बढ़ैत धुँआ के बीच मस्जिद के मीनार पर चढ़ैत, एकटा मौजूदा झंडा हटाबैत, आ ओकर जगह पर केसर (भगवा) के झंडा फहराबैत देखा रहल अछि. एहि लेख मे पोस्ट मे कएल गेल दावा के सत्यापन करी.

संग्रहीत पोस्ट एतय भेटत।

दावा : वीडियो मे नेपाल मे 2026 के अशांति के बीच प्रदर्शनकारी मस्जिद के मीनार पर चढ़ि केसर (भगवा) के झंडा फहराबैत देखा रहल अछि. तथ्य : नेपाल मे २०२६ मे भेल अशांति के दौरान प्रदर्शनकारी मस्जिद के मीनार पर चढ़ि केसर (भगवा) के झंडा फहराबैत नहि देखा रहल अछि । ई फरवरी २०२० केरऽ एगो पुरानऽ वीडियो छेकै जेकरा म॑ सीएए स॑ जुड़लऽ सांप्रदायिक हिंसा के दौरान दिल्ली केरऽ अशोक नगर म॑ बड़ी मस्जिद म॑ तोड़फोड़ करलऽ गेलऽ छै । एहि लेल पोस्ट मे जे दावा कएल गेल अछि ओ भ्रामक अछि।

वायरल वीडियो स॑ प्रमुख फ्रेमऽ के रिवर्स इमेज सर्च स॑ हमरा सब क॑ फरवरी २०२० म॑ प्रकाशित कईएक मीडिया रिपोर्ट (एत॑, यहाँ, आरू यहाँ) मिललै जेकरा म॑ एक ही विजुअल के विशेषता छेलै । ई खबरऽ के अनुसार ई वीडियो म॑ नागरिकता संशोधन अधिनियम (सीएए) के खिलाफ विरोध प्रदर्शन स॑ जुड़लऽ साम्प्रदायिक हिंसा के दौरान दिल्ली केरऽ अशोक नगर म॑ बड़ी मस्जिद म॑ तोड़फोड़ के घटना देखलऽ गेलऽ छै । मस्जिद में आगि लगा देल गेल, आ भीड़ ओकर मीनार पर चढ़ि, मौजूदा झंडा के हटा देलक, आ केसर के हनुमान झंडा के संग भारतीय राष्ट्रीय झंडा फहरा देलक. एहि रिपोर्ट मे विजुअल वायरल वीडियो स मेल खाइत अछि जे ई पुष्टि करैत अछि जे ई फरवरी 2020 मे दिल्ली स आयल पुरान वीडियो अछि आ नेपाल मे 2026 मे भेल अशांति स संबंधित नहि अछि।

हमरा सब क॑ एक ही घटना क॑ कवर करै वाला कईएक अन्य मीडिया रिपोर्ट भी मिललै, जेकरा एत॑, यहाँ, आरू एत॑ देखलऽ जाब॑ सकै छै ।

2020 के दिल्ली दंगा 23 स 27 फरवरी तक पूर्वोत्तर दिल्ली में नागरिकता (संशोधन) अधिनियम (सीएए) के ल क झड़प के बीच भेल छल। एहि हिंसा मे 53 लोकक जान गेल आ घर, व्यवसाय, आ पूजा स्थल (एतय, एतय) के व्यापक नुकसान पहुंचल.

संक्षेप मे कहल जाय त दिल्ली के एकटा पुरान, असंबंधित वीडियो झूठ शेयर कएल गेल अछि, जेकरा नेपाल मे 2026 के अशांति सं जोड़ल गेल अछि.

full_article:
Before He returned to heaven, the Lord Jesus called His disciples together on the mountainside in Galilee.

There He proclaimed, “All authority in heaven and on earth has been given to me. Therefore go and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit, and teaching them to obey everything I have commanded you” (Matthew 28:18-20).

This is the Great Commission – the Church’s call to evangelize the world.

Your call.

Church leaders in Nepal share in the poverty and hardship that affects so many. [Image credit: IanKGibson/Wikipedia]

Right now, this call is being enacted by evangelists in Nepal – local believers seeking to make Christ known among their fellow countrymen.

They are working in a context of hostility, in which Christians are treated with suspicion and sometimes even violence by religious nationalists among the Hindu majority, while also enduring severe poverty and hardship.

They need your help.

Our project partner wants to set up three sustainable livestock initiatives – chickens, pigs, and cows – in order to generate an income to support the work of evangelism and discipleship.

“Profits generated from these initiatives will be reinvested into local ministry activities, supporting evangelism, discipleship, church planting, and outreach among the least-reached communities,” says our partner.

“The project will also provide practical examples of local sustainability and stewardship for churches and Christian ministries throughout Nepal.”

Can you help strengthen the Church in Nepal?

God willing, we will provide 200 chickens, ten pigs, and ten cows.

But none of this is possible without you.

By donating today, you are taking part in the Great Commission, the call of Christ. By praying, you can remind your brothers and sisters that Christ is with them always, all the way to the end (Matthew 28:20).

How You Can Pray Lord God and Heavenly Father, thank You for the faithful service of Your people in Nepal in seeking to make Christ known. We pray that the provision of these animals will enable this work to continue and grow. Please continue to bless their ministry of evangelism and discipleship, for we ask it in the Name of Christ, our only Saviour.

How You Can Give

$6 could purchase five baby chickens.

$71 could purchase one pig.

$290 could purchase one cow.

स्वर्ग वापसी सँ पहिने प्रभु यीशु अपन शिष्य सभ केँ गलील मे पहाड़क ढाल पर एक ठाम बजौलनि।

ओतय ओ घोषणा केलनि, “स्वर्ग आ पृथ्वी पर सभ अधिकार हमरा देल गेल अछि, तेँ जाउ आ सभ जाति केँ शिष्य बनाउ, ओकरा सभ केँ पिता आ पुत्र आ पवित्र आत्माक नाम सँ बपतिस्मा दियौक आ ओकरा सभ केँ सिखाउ जे हम अहाँ सभ केँ जे किछु आज्ञा देलहुँ, ओकर पालन करबाक लेल” (मत्ती 28:18-20)।

ई महान आज्ञा छै – दुनिया के सुसमाचार प्रचार करै के लेलऽ कलीसिया के आह्वान ।

अहाँक फोन।

एतेक लोक के जे गरीबी आ कठिनाई प्रभावित करैत अछि ओहि मे नेपाल के चर्च के नेता के हिस्सेदारी अछि. [चित्र श्रेय: IanKGibson/विकिपीडिया]

अभी ई आह्वान नेपाल केरऽ सुसमाचार प्रचारक – स्थानीय विश्वासी सिनी द्वारा लागू करलऽ जाय रहलऽ छै जे अपनऽ देशवासी के बीच मसीह क॑ पहचानै के कोशिश करी रहलऽ छै ।

ई सब दुश्मनी के संदर्भ म॑ काम करी रहलऽ छै, जेकरा म॑ हिन्दू बहुसंख्यक के बीच धार्मिक राष्ट्रवादी सिनी द्वारा ईसाई सिनी के साथ शंका आरू कखनी-कखनी हिंसा भी करलऽ जाय छै, जबकि घोर गरीबी आरू कठिनाई भी सहन करलऽ जाय छै ।

हुनका सभकेँ अहाँक मदद चाही।

हमरऽ परियोजना भागीदार तीन टिकाऊ पशुधन पहल – मुर्गी, सुअर, आरू गाय – स्थापित करना चाहै छै ताकि सुसमाचार प्रचार आरू शिष्यत्व के काम म॑ सहायता लेली आय पैदा करलऽ जाय सक॑ ।

हमरऽ साथी कहै छै, “ई पहलऽ स॑ मिललऽ मुनाफा क॑ स्थानीय मंत्रालय गतिविधियऽ म॑ पुनर्निवेश करलऽ जैतै, जेकरा स॑ सुसमाचार प्रचार, शिष्यत्व, चर्च रोपनी, आरू कम स॑ कम पहुँच वाला समुदायऽ के बीच आउटरीच के समर्थन करलऽ जैतै ।

“ई परियोजना स॑ पूरा नेपाल म॑ चर्च आरू ईसाई मंत्रालय लेली स्थानीय स्थायित्व आरू संचालन के व्यावहारिक उदाहरण भी मिलतै।”

की अहां नेपाल मे चर्च के मजबूत करय मे मदद करि सकय छी?

भगवान् चाहथि त हम सब 200 मुर्गी, दस टा सुग्गर, आ दस टा गाय के इंतजाम करब।

मुदा एहि मे सँ कोनो बात अहाँक बिना संभव नहि अछि।

आइ दान क' क' अहाँ महान आज्ञा, मसीहक आह्वान मे भाग ल' रहल छी। प्रार्थना क’ क’, अहाँ अपन भाइ-बहिन सभ केँ मोन पाड़ि सकैत छी जे मसीह हुनका सभक संग सदिखन छथि, अंत धरि (मत्ती 28:20)।

अहाँ कोना प्रार्थना क सकैत छी प्रभु परमेश्वर आ स्वर्गीय पिता, मसीह के जनाबय के कोशिश में नेपाल में अपन लोक के निष्ठावान सेवा के लेल धन्यवाद। हम सब प्रार्थना करैत छी जे एहि जानवर सब के प्रावधान स ई काज आगू बढ़य आ बढ़य में सक्षम होयत। कृपया हुनका लोकनिक सुसमाचार प्रचार आ शिष्य बनबाक सेवा केँ आशीर्वाद दैत रहू, कारण हम सभ एकरा मसीहक नाम सँ माँगैत छी, जे हमर एकमात्र उद्धारकर्ता छथि।

अहाँ कोना द सकैत छी

6 डॉलर मे पांचटा बच्चा मुर्गी खरीदल जा सकैत छल।

71 डॉलर मे एकटा सुग्गर खरीदल जा सकैत छल।

290 डॉलर मे एकटा गाय खरीदल जा सकैत छल।
